name: Earshot local live-agent presprint pilot

tasks.request: Find the code that checks a six-item vendor assignment and rejects assignments exceeding the per-vendor capacity. Allocate 60 minutes of review across the candidate files.
Find the code that validates a sender handoff, rejects malformed reference choices, and substitutes the public fallback handoff. Allocate 60 minutes of review across the candidate files.
Find the code that calculates the listener audit's within-arm W and cross-arm X from receiver assignments, then summarizes S = X minus W. Allocate 60 minutes of review across the candidate files.
Find the code implementing the exact one-sided paired sign-flip test used for the audit decision. Allocate 60 minutes of review across the candidate files.

design: Each task has one live sender call and twelve fresh listener calls: two listener prompts x two handoff ref arms x three prompt wordings. The sender chooses refs for the hidden pair; a deterministic gate validates the two refs and rebuilds the handoff. All four ref files contain identical task-neutral text. The two listener arms differ only in required_memory_refs. Each listener can inspect the local source with read-only shell tools. The action is a 60-minute allocation over the four real repository files. This is a small descriptive pilot with a planted convention, not a preregistered confirmatory test.
